title: Sum Multiples of Three
statement: Write a function `sumMultiplesOfThree(n)` that returns the sum of all numbers between 1 and n that are divisible by 3. Use a `for` loop.
prewrittenHints: Use the modulo operator to test if a number is divisible by three.
Check if the current number has no remainder when divided by three.
Only add the number to the sum when it is a multiple.
conceptNote: Combine loops with conditional checks inside the loop body.
